page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 224.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core, supporting workloads that require substantial parallel processing power alongside standard host memory.

The instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, delivering a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. This hardware acceleration is suited for processing graphical, inference, or video transcoding tasks. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge offers a specialized hardware profile that balances a high virtual core count with dual dedicated GPUs. This makes it a resource-dense option for legacy GPU workloads, avoiding the higher costs associated with newer, larger accelerator architectures when extreme compute density is not required.

Given the combination of 56 dedicated vCPUs, 224.0 GB of RAM, and dual NVIDIA P4 GPUs, this server type is configured for workloads such as small-scale deep learning inference, video transcoding, media streaming, and parallelized compute tasks that benefit from GPU acceleration without requiring massive local storage.
